message.content:
**Command palette overlay is OPEN.**

The screenshot shows a centered modal dialog with a search input ("Search chats or run a command") and a list of suggested commands (New chat, Open folder, Search files, Settings, etc.) with keyboard shortcuts. The background is dimmed/grayed out, which is characteristic of an active command palette overlay (triggered by Ctrl+K as indicated by the tooltip). It is not the Activity panel or a normal view without overlays.
